newsitem.title: UK: UK's Wassall offers to redeem 'B' shares.
newsitem.headline: UK's Wassall offers to redeem 'B' shares.

text.p: British diversified industrial company Wassall Plc offered on Tuesday to redeem up to 200 million 'B' shares at 76 pence each to return about 150 million stg to its shareholders.
Wassall's offer follows last week's public offering of 16.9 million shares in its U.S. subsidiary General Cable Corp on the New York Stock Exchange.
Wassall had earlier said it expected net proceeds of about 202 million stg from the float of GCC, which was made at $21 per share.
The IPO represented 70 percent of GCC's issued share capital.
The company said reorganisation of its capital would be implemented on May 27 and the return of value to shareholders will take place on May 28.
